entities.name: PTGS2 T8473C
observations: The T8473C polymorphism is located in the PTGS2/COX-2 3′ untranslated region.
In 189 Tunisian NPC patients and 237 healthy controls, the CC genotype was associated with decreased NPC risk: OR 0.37, 95% CI 0.17–0.81, p=0.013; the C allele OR was 0.72, 95% CI 0.53–0.97, p=0.032.

entities.name: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma
observations: The primary Tunisian study evaluated 189 patients and 237 healthy controls.
The accessible abstract does not report exact CC/TC/TT genotype counts or percentages.

entities.name: PMID:25438689
observations: The 2015 Pathologie-biologie study concluded that PTGS2 T8473C CC genotype and C allele were associated with decreased nasopharyngeal carcinoma risk in Tunisians; multivariable analysis retained significance for CC (p=0.013).

entities.name: PTGS2 -765G>C
observations: This distinct promoter polymorphism was associated with increased, not decreased, NPC risk among Tunisian C-allele carriers: OR 1.76, p=0.01; adjusted OR 1.89, p=0.008.

entities.name: PMID:17968676
observations: The 2009 Molecular Biology Reports study evaluated 180 Tunisian NPC patients and 169 controls and found the PTGS2 -765C allele associated with increased NPC risk and adverse disease features.
